probe: V-26 seg2: does Closing Balance carry prior-period amounts on P&L accounts

DECISIVE_seg2.implication: if closing_carries_prior_period_amounts is true, Closing Balance is a running balance from the beginning of time, NOT a fiscal-year-to-date figure -- so it only equals 本年累计金额 while no prior year has P&L activity, or while a Period Closing Voucher zeroes it at year end
